body: COLD-START EXECUTABILITY CORRECTION, independent of the appointment objection. The stated recall-to-video outcome is a valid product priority, but the controlling movie plan does not currently authorize implementing that end-to-end vertical. Sections 12 and 14 say the next executable library vertical is P1, the real-transcript Stage 1b provider gate bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG, and that P1 remains outstanding. C1 begins only after P1 and B0 both close. B0 is also open because no exact source-film plus human-recall pair is admitted; the Sherlock artifact-level licence and human-recall REB/redistribution bases require owner action. The current Scala search confirms no film/media time contract implementation exists yet, as expected. Therefore the actionable priority is: recover and resolve the exact V12 contract successor; advance the already-assigned P1 provider seam; obtain or explicitly replace the B0 owner dispositions; then authorize C1. Starting a movie adapter or claiming an end-to-end film mapping now would violate the plan and Article IX. I volunteer as independent reviewer for P1 or the first later mapping/output slice, with focus on exact evidence, proposal authority, coverage and abstention, time-axis identity, and partial-delivery output. No implementation or source-access authority inferred.
